name: Stormwind Stockade (Classic)
summary: A revolt has put the prisoners in control beneath Stormwind City's canal district. The Stockade lies beside the canals between Old Town and the Mage Quarter.

sections.title: A Prison in Revolt
sections.body: Warden Thelwater oversees the Stockade, where Stormwind holds its most dangerous prisoners. Among them are Defias Brotherhood cutthroats, a Blackrock orc, an ogre and a Dark Iron dwarf. Then Bazil Thredd led a coordinated riot that overwhelmed the garrison. The surviving guards fled, and prisoners now rule the halls.

sections.title: Bureaucracy and Retribution
sections.body: Stormwind's rule has deep cracks. Targorr the Dread, a feared Blackrock orc, and Dextren Ward, a grave robber who sold bodies, were both sentenced to death. Yet influential nobles kept them alive through endless stays of execution. Fed up with the delays, Lakeshire, Darkshire and the dwarven garrison at Dun Modr bypassed royal channels. They hired outsiders to enter the chaos and execute key ringleaders.

faq.answer: The Stockade entrance lies inside Stormwind City, along the northern canal bank between Old Town and the Cathedral and Mage districts.

faq.q: Who is currently running the prison?
aliases: who is in charge of stockade
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater is the prison's official warden, but the rebellion drove him out. Bazil Thredd started the uprising and now controls the prison with allied Defias rioters.

faq.q: Why are there orcs and Dark Iron dwarves locked up in Stormwind?
aliases: why are there orcs in stockade
faq.answer: Stormwind holds prisoners of war and saboteurs there. Targorr the Dread is a captured Blackrock orc raider from the nearby mountains, and Kam Deepfury is a Dark Iron dwarf imprisoned for subversion against the Alliance.

faq.q: Why were condemned murderers kept alive instead of executed?
faq.answer: Stormwind nobles repeatedly delayed executions for convicts such as Dextren Ward and Targorr. Their political interference and bureaucratic delays angered outer territories such as Redridge and Duskwood.

angles.text: The riot beneath the capital's streets humiliates Highlord Bolvar Fordragon's administration. It shows Stormwind's vulnerability from within while the king remains absent.
For humans in the outlying towns, the Stockade's failure shows that the House of Nobles puts legal delays in the capital ahead of protecting border settlements from murderers.
